summary: Formal independent structural finite element solver qualification evidence report for SECP-ENGINE-QUALIFICATION-002-FSI-STRUCTURAL-SOLVER-QUALIFICATION-001. Establishes sub-ppm analytical closed-form agreement, physical linearity and sensitivity verification, exact boundary reaction equilibrium balance, adversarial input rejection, and NAFEMS standard Quad4 patch test validation. Confirms the structural solver is qualified for bar and quad formulations while strictly isolating this qualification from the multiphysics FSI coupling gate.
